triage.note: Bridgecrest Lending Auto Securitization Trust 2024-1, FY2024. Legally a 10-K; substantively an asset-backed issuer's annual report under General Instruction J to Form 10-K, whose substance is Items 1112(b)/1114(b)(2)/1117/1119/1122/1123 of Regulation AB, NOT Items 1-16 of Regulation S-K. The document says so twice, in its own words: 'The following items have been omitted in accordance with General Instruction J to Form 10-K' and 'Substitute information provided in accordance with General Instruction J to Form 10-K'. BEFORE THE FIX the pipeline returned doc_status=success_with_warning with 18 of 23 items `extracted`, most at confidence 0.95 -- including an 'Item 7 Management's Discussion and Analysis' of 96 chars at 0.80 and an 'Item 8 Financial Statements' of 54 chars at 0.80. That is precisely the failure the contract's refusal statuses exist to prevent: a plausible-looking item set over a document whose taxonomy we do not model. The five items it reported `missing` (1, 1A, 1C, 2, 3) are exactly the five the filing lists as omitted under Instruction J, so even the `missing` calls were wrong in kind -- the filing is not silent about them, it declares them inapplicable. Correct behaviour is the refusal the README already promises: 'unsupported and failed mean the pipeline refused; it never emits a best-effort parse of a document it could not identify.'
